answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy ties validator identities to acoustic propagation telemetry. Nodes prove physical presence by recording acoustic pulses emitted by a beacon across an open terrace using a calibrated jade transducer. Because terrain reverberation resists real-time software simulation, an adversary must deploy dedicated hardware transceivers per identity. However, ambient wind noise distorts sonic waveforms, occasionally rejecting honest agents.
